They Nerf it...... :(

This is my new legendary space science pack ship. The old one will no longer work for 2.1 because they are not allowing the quality reprocessing recipe anymore.

With my current research, 260% asteroid productivity, this ship is producing on average between 3,000 and 5,000 legendary space science packs per minute.

One note about this ship: if you don’t have enough laser power research, you might have issues with this blueprint. My laser power research is at 25, so if your laser power is low, I think you may face some problems.

I feel like 4k–5k per minute is still low, and I’m trying to improve it, but for now this is the ship.
title: 2.1 Legendary Space Science Pack
